 David Hoffman USA TODAY Nov. 19, 2026, 2:26 p.m. ET Hear this story Black Friday Prime Video add-on subscription deals run from Nov. 19-30.
 Top add-on deals available includes AMC+, Apple TV+, HBO Max, Paramount+ and more, all of which are available for a fraction of their regular price.
 Black Friday deals are starting to roll out ahead of the top savings event of the year, and that includes Amazon Prime Video's add-on subscriptions .
 With friends and family flocking to your home over the next two months, it's the perfect time to add new streaming services to your lineup so you're able to watch top movies, TV shows and live sporting events...with or without your extended family, that's the host's choice!
 More: The best early Black Friday streaming deals start at just $2.99 Prime Video's Black Friday deals end on Nov. 30 , so now is the time to save. Among the most popular subscriptions available for less are Apple TV+ , HBO Max , Paramount+ , Starz , Hallmark+ and more.
 Ready to enjoy countless new streaming options while being friendly on your wallet? Shop the full roundup below.
 Don't miss out! Get weekly deals, trends and product recommendations from USA TODAY Shopping delivered straight to your inbox. Shop Prime Video Black Friday add-on deals Prime Video Black Friday add-on deals
 Apple TV+ Black Friday deal
 You can add Apple TV+ for only $6.99/month for 6 months , compared to the $14.99/month standard price.
 With Apple TV+, you can watch top shows like 'Ted Lasso,' and 'Slow Horses' along with every Formula One race.

 Shop Prime Video add-on deals When do Amazon Black Friday deals start?
 Amazon Black Friday 2026 starts Thursday, Nov. 19 and runs through Monday, Nov. 30 .
 That means shoppers will have 12 days of deals , including Thanksgiving on Nov. 26, Black Friday on Nov. 27 and Cyber Monday on Nov. 30.
 The timing also tracks closely with Amazon's previous sales. In 2025, Amazon's Black Friday and Cyber Monday event began Nov. 20 and continued through Dec. 1.
 Shop Amazon's early Black Friday deals Grab an Amazon Prime membership to shop and save
 If you've been on the fence, now is the perfect time to consider signing up for an Amazon Prime membership seriously. Beyond the deals we just mentioned, a Prime membership offers plenty of valuable perks, including convenient free same-day, one-day and two-day delivery options. Plus, you can start with a free 30-day trial to see if this membership works for you.
